nodes.description: Public string state variable 'name' storing the human readable token name ("PW.GL"); writable only through setName() guarded by isOwner.
Public string state variable 'symbol' storing the token ticker ("PWG").
Public uint256 state variable 'decimals' = 8, used only for display precision.
Public mapping(address => uint256) 'balanceOf' holding token balances; mutated in constructor, transfer, transferFrom and burn.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) 'allowance' holding spender approvals; written by approve and decremented by transferFrom.
Public uint256 'totalSupply' initialized to 0 and set once to valueFounder in the constructor; never updated afterwards.
Public bool 'stopped' circuit breaker flag toggled by stop()/start() and read by the isRunning modifier.
Constant uint256 'valueFounder' (88888888866666666) used to seed totalSupply and the founder's balance at deployment.
Address state variable 'owner', set to msg.sender in the constructor and asserted against msg.sender by the isOwner modifier.
Deprecated-style constructor PWGLToken(address _addressFounder): sets owner, totalSupply and the founder balance, then emits Transfer.
transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) with isRunning and validAddress modifiers; performs unchecked balance updates that can underflow/overflow in Solidity 0.4.24.
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) with isRunning and validAddress modifiers; performs unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic.
approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) with isRunning and validAddress modifiers; enforces zero-first approval rule and writes allowance.
stop() guarded by isOwner; sets stopped = true, halting transfer, transferFrom and approve.
start() guarded by isOwner; sets stopped = false, re-enabling token transfers.
setName(string _name) guarded by isOwner; overwrites the token name state variable.
burn(uint256 _value) with no access control; subtracts from msg.sender and adds to balanceOf[0x0] using unchecked arithmetic.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, balance lookups and allowance keys.
Unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value in transfer; no SafeMath, susceptible to arithmetic issues.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value, balanceOf[_to] += _value and allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value and balanceOf[0x0] += _value in burn; also permanently locks value at the zero address.
Constructor parameter _addressFounder: address receiving the entire initial supply.
Destination address parameter _to shared by transfer and transferFrom.
Amount parameter _value used by transfer, transferFrom and burn.
Source address parameter _from of transferFrom.
Spender address parameter _spender of approve.
New token name parameter _name of setName.

edges.reason: Constructor sets owner = msg.sender, propagating caller identity into state.
Constructor writes the owner state variable with the deployer address.
isOwner modifier on stop() asserts owner == msg.sender, so caller identity gates this privileged function.
isOwner modifier on start() asserts owner == msg.sender, gating the circuit breaker reset.
isOwner modifier on setName() asserts owner == msg.sender, gating metadata mutation.
msg.sender balance is read and debited inside transfer.
msg.sender is the allowance key and required to be non-zero by validAddress in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the owner key of the allowance mapping written by approve.
burn() debits balanceOf[msg.sender] with no authorization check.
owner state variable is read by the isOwner modifier that guards execution of stop().
owner state variable is read by the isOwner modifier that guards execution of start().
owner state variable is read by the isOwner modifier that guards execution of setName().
isRunning modifier checks stopped before transfer executes.
isRunning modifier checks stopped before transferFrom executes.
isRunning modifier checks stopped before approve executes.
stop() writes stopped = true, disabling the guarded functions.
start() writes stopped = false, re-enabling the guarded functions.
Constant valueFounder is read by the constructor to initialize supply.
Constructor assigns totalSupply = valueFounder.
Constructor mints the whole supply to balanceOf[_addressFounder].
_addressFounder parameter is used as the recipient key in the constructor mint.
_to parameter supplies the credit address of transfer.
_to parameter supplies the credit address of transferFrom.
_value parameter supplies the transfer amount.
_value parameter supplies the transferFrom amount.
_value parameter supplies the burn amount.
Caller-supplied _value flows into the unchecked subtraction in transfer.
Caller-supplied _value flows into the unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic in transferFrom.
Caller-supplied _value flows into the unchecked arithmetic in burn.
_from parameter selects the debited account and allowance owner in transferFrom.
_spender parameter is the approval target in approve.
_name parameter is written into the name state variable by setName.
balanceOf values are mutated by unchecked arithmetic in transfer.
balanceOf values are mutated by unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
balanceOf values are mutated by unchecked arithmetic in burn.
allowance entry is decremented without overflow protection in transferFrom.
transfer persists the updated balanceOf entries for sender and recipient.
transferFrom persists the updated balanceOf entries for _from and _to.
transferFrom persists the decremented allowance entry.
approve stores the new allowance for msg.sender/_spender.
burn persists the debit of msg.sender and the credit of the zero address.

normalization_plan.reason: _addressFounder is a constructor-only parameter whose sole effect is the initial mint recipient inside PWGLToken(); it has no standalone semantics.
_to is a transient argument identifying the credit account of transfer/transferFrom and should be folded into the transfer function context.
_value is the untrusted amount driving the unchecked balance arithmetic in transfer, so it is normalized into the unsafe arithmetic operation.
_from is a transient argument selecting the debited account and allowance owner in transferFrom.
_spender is a transient argument naming the approval target in approve and carries no independent state.
_name is a transient argument written directly into the name state variable by setName and should be folded into that function.
